capabilities: create a ZIP backup of the whole vault in a .backup/ folder
copy the backup to up to two external drives
verify each copy by SHA-256 comparison before renaming
prune old backups, keeping the 3 newest per destination
run backups via commands, ribbon icon, and hotkeys
extras: Desktop only; tested on Linux, Windows not supported yet. No network use or telemetry. Unreviewed by Obsidian staff per manifest note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce complete, verified vault backups to local folders and external drives on demand.

requires.name: zip, 7z or bsdtar (optional: 7z or unzip for verification)

summary: Backup utility that creates verified ZIP archives of the whole vault locally and on up to two external drives, keeping the 3 newest copies in each place.
